# SYS-001: Distribution is one stackward is tested on

- **Group:** System
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Collectors detect mechanisms rather than assume versions, but parsers are only tested on Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 and Debian 12 and 13. On anything else results are more likely to come back unknown, and a pass deserves less trust.

## Verify by hand

```sh
cat /etc/os-release
```

## How to fix it

Run on Ubuntu 22.04 or later, or Debian 12 or later, or read results from other distributions with care.

Run `stackward explain SYS-001` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
